title: Checks for any usage of __cached__ and __file__ as an argument to logging.getLogger().
summary: The logging documentation recommends this pattern: Ruff takes this rule from flake8-logging and made it stable in v0.2.0.

title: Checks for .exception() logging calls outside of exception handlers.
summary: The documentation states: > This function should only be called from an exception handler. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-logging and made it stable in 0.16.0.

title: Checks for uses of logging.exception() with exc_info set to False.
summary: The logging.exception() method captures the exception automatically, but accepts an optional exc_info argument to override this behavior. Setting exc_info to False disables the automatic capture of the exception and stack trace. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-logging and made it stable in v0.2.0.

title: Checks for uses of logging.WARN.
summary: The logging.WARN constant is an undocumented alias for logging.WARNING. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-logging and made it stable in v0.2.0.

title: Checks for logging calls with exc_info= outside exception handlers.
summary: Using exc_info=True outside of an exception handler attaches None as the exception information, leading to confusing messages: Ruff takes this rule from flake8-logging and made it stable in 0.12.0.

title: Checks for usages of the following logging top-level functions: debug, info, warn, warning, error, critical, log, exception.
summary: Using the root logger causes the messages to have no source information, making them less useful for debugging. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-logging and made it stable in 0.10.0.
